purpose: Define shared and Program Discovery-specific fields for a Layer 2 method-selection evidence package. This registry supports branch-local reasoning only.
non_goals: No Layer 4 adapter or rewrite decisions.
No callable signatures, environment capsules, runtime-support claims, or default-method policy.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method name from the frozen candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: copy exactly from candidate_freeze

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short family label from the frozen registry.
fields.fill_rule: copy from input unless obviously normalized

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: Primary data objects expected by the method.
fields.fill_rule: use frozen title/evidence plus conservative synthesis
fields.topic_relevance: Separates spot, subcellular, single-cell-resolution, reference, and gene-set-dependent routes.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Program Discovery role used in this package.
fields.fill_rule: state topic-local use, not all possible uses

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: Primary analytical output relevant to Program Discovery.
fields.fill_rule: describe output type without runtime claims
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes topics, factors, networks, gradients, conservative regulatory-program outputs, and tissue modules.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearest methods inside the frozen set.
fields.fill_rule: list frozen candidates only

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main differentiator against close alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Layer 2 synthesis based on frozen evidence
fields.topic_relevance: Explains why a branch points to one method family.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Compute label from frozen registry.
fields.fill_rule: copy frozen Compute Requirement
fields.controlled_values: CPU; Optional GPU; Required GPU; unclear
fields.topic_relevance: Resource gate only, not runtime support.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Conservative memory burden estimate.
fields.fill_rule: use unclear unless directly supported or clearly implied by scale/model class

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Sensitivity to number of spots/cells/genes/samples.
fields.fill_rule: conservative Layer 2 synthesis

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Code availability status from frozen Accessibility/GitHub fields.
fields.fill_rule: available only with frozen public GitHub; otherwise pending/manual review

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: Primary public code URL when frozen input provides one.
fields.fill_rule: copy frozen GitHub URL or unclear

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Direct evidence pointer.
fields.fill_rule: include frozen registry row plus PMID/DOI

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Separation of direct evidence from synthesis.
fields.fill_rule: must name direct registry/PubMed evidence and Layer 2 synthesis separately

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Conditional branch-local use case.
fields.fill_rule: write as when-to-read/consider, not default

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Conditional branch-local exclusion/caution.
fields.fill_rule: state when another branch should be considered first

fields.name: Program Family
fields.definition: Topic-specific normalized program-discovery family.
fields.fill_rule: choose a short label from row evidence and synthesis
fields.controlled_values: factor / NMF; multicellular latent program; tensor decomposition; probabilistic latent variable; spatial topic model; probabilistic spatial factor; gene-set correlation; spatial co-expression network; boundary-sensitive regulatory-program output; interaction-aware tissue module; spatial co-expression model; spatial gradient analysis

fields.name: Program Output Type
fields.definition: Topic-specific output shape.
fields.fill_rule: describe what a user would inspect downstream
fields.topic_relevance: Separates factors, topics, networks, gradients, conservative regulatory-program outputs, and modules.

fields.name: Spatial Coupling
fields.definition: How spatial information enters the method.
fields.fill_rule: use concise conservative phrase

fields.name: Reference Dependence
fields.definition: Dependence on annotations, gene sets, regulatory priors, or external references.
fields.fill_rule: state reference-free or dependency class; use unclear when unsupported
fields.controlled_values: reference-free; annotation-dependent; optional/reference-informed; gene-set-dependent; regulatory-prior-dependent; unclear

fields.name: Multi-sample Cue
fields.definition: Whether the method naturally supports multi-sample/cohort program discovery.
fields.fill_rule: use strong/suited/can support/unclear style from evidence

fields.name: Interpretability Caveat
fields.definition: Main caution when interpreting programs.
fields.fill_rule: Layer 2 scientific-critical-thinking caveat
